header.title: Counselor Pools
header.description: A pool groups counselors and decides how leads from its campaigns get auto-assigned. Each campaign can belong to only one pool.

emptyState.message: No pools yet. Create your first pool to start auto-assigning leads.

deleteDialog.title: Delete pool "{{name}}"?
deleteDialog.description: This permanently removes the pool, its shift schedule, and all member configuration. Counselors assigned to existing leads are not affected; new leads on this pool's campaigns will no longer be auto-assigned.
deleteDialog.campaignsAttachedWarning_one: This pool still has {{count}} campaign attached. You must remove all campaigns from the pool first.
deleteDialog.campaignsAttachedWarning_other: This pool still has {{count}} campaigns attached. You must remove all campaigns from the pool first.
